_readme: Catalogue pages whose image-to-product pairing has been checked by eye.
The importer pairs products with photographs by reading order wherever a page
has exactly one photograph per product. That is strong evidence, not proof —
so those products stay in the verification queue until their page is listed
here. Listing a page means someone has opened the extracted images for it and
confirmed that image N really is product N.
To verify a page: open public/blaupunkt/catalogue/bp-<page>-<n>.jpg, check the
model printed on the product against the parsed order in
src/lib/data/blaupunkt/catalog.generated.json, then add the page number here
This file is hand-maintained and survives a re-import. Corrections never go

notes.note: Position 1 is printed VA 1004 and position 4 is the monoblock, matching the spec table's 1-channel column. Order confirmed at both ends of the row.

Position 1 pairs to the 2.100D. The product label reads 'CDx 2.100D' where the PDF text layer gives 'ODx 2.100D' — model number matches, series letter does not. Confirm with Blaupunkt which is correct before this SKU is advertised.
